invariant.portable_principle: A durable TypeScript subsystem map may claim complete module facts only when a host-pinned compiler and named tsconfig establish eligible inventory, exports, and static import resolution; unavailable and unresolved facts stay visible.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Preserve the existing Python AST inventory, clustering, renderer, ruff, and silent-catch workflow unchanged.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: One family-local Node Compiler API command parses a named project-local tsconfig, creates a Program, resolves direct and paths-alias imports, enumerates exports, and writes matching Markdown and JSON artifacts.
explicit_non_goals: TypeScript responsibility clusters or judgment-oriented open questions
Dynamic import, runtime-loading, call-graph, reference, or deletion analysis
Framework, React, Node, ORM, receiver, or API identity inference
A global TypeScript parser or fact platform

reference_repairs: Kept the Python map stages and render_doc.py behavior intact; no Python reference defect was found.
Made Python-only clusters/open questions and unconfigured ESLint explicit unavailable fields rather than false zero-count fields.
Made direct excluded targets, symlink paths, unresolved imports, syntax failure, missing tsconfig, and missing TypeScript explicit outcomes.

syntax: Exported module symbols including alias status
type_system: A Compiler Program and TypeChecker enumerate module export symbols.
Target pre-emit diagnostics are compliance evidence; syntax diagnostics block the map.
module_resolution: The named tsconfig supplies compiler options including baseUrl and paths aliases.
resolveModuleName establishes direct relative and alias destinations.
Parsed project references are passed to createProgram, but cross-project package/reference completeness is not claimed.
runtime: Host Node plus TypeScript resolved from host package.json.
framework: No framework assumption; TSX is a source extension only.

tooling.selected: Family-local TypeScript Compiler API Program/TypeChecker plus one named tsconfig resolver in map_typescript.mjs.

rejected_alternatives.lexical_import_inventory: Cannot establish alias destinations or distinguish unresolved edges from a complete graph.
rejected_alternatives.ts_morph_or_tree_sitter: Adds another dependency without improving the accepted Compiler API module-fact outcome.
rejected_alternatives.shared_parser_platform: No actual second consumer proves an identical resolver, output, failure, and installed-closure contract.
rejected_alternatives.inferred_eslint: Inventing a lint policy or reporting zero violations would be less honest than an unavailable field.

tooling.version_and_resolution: The fixture lock pins TypeScript 5.9.3. Installed execution requires package.json and resolves TypeScript from that host only; it rejects a package outside project root.
tooling.closure_mode: The selected map-subsystem directory bundles the Node mapper and TypeScript v1 knowledge. Its documented command finds .agents or .claude and never invokes repository scripts, sibling skills, or a toolkit venv.
preflight_and_failure_codes: Exit 2 for missing target, symbolic-link target, missing/invalid tsconfig, missing host TypeScript, or TypeScript syntax error.
Emit partial with unresolved_imports for unresolved or symlink-blocked selected static imports.
Emit explicit unavailable records for TypeScript v1 fields outside the contract.

inputs: Selected TS/TSX feature package with direct and alias consumers, barrel, workflow doc, and exclusion corpus
must_fire: Three selected source files and five exported symbols
One explicit barrel boundary and one workflow-map entry
One unresolved alias produces partial rather than complete
must_not_fire: Generated, vendor, test/spec, declaration, bundle, minified, dependency, build, and fixture source
Direct excluded directory and file targets
Internal or external directory symlink traversal
Artifact output or evidence path overwriting source or traversing an ancestor symlink
A missing TypeScript package, tsconfig, or syntax error represented as a clean map
Python-only clusters/open questions or invented ESLint counts

python_reference: tests/test_skill_taxonomy.py passed with the updated frontmatter.
typescript: tests/test_map_subsystem_typescript.py asserts final Markdown/JSON artifacts, resolved direct/alias edges, barrel/workflow evidence, partial/error states, root-relative exclusions, symlink containment, copied stock install, and no checkout runtime.
A clean external host ran the installed documented commands and wrote complete map artifacts without source mutation.
commands_and_artifact_paths: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check tests/test_map_subsystem_typescript.py: All checks passed
.venv/bin/python scripts/skill_meta.py lint: OK — 76 skills, 76 declaring new contract

fresh_forward.task: Install only map-subsystem into a clean TypeScript host, run the installed documented command for src/features, and inspect the final map without editing source.
fresh_forward.result: Complete compiler-backed map: 3 source files, 5 exported symbols, 2 resolved outbound imports, 2 resolved inbound imports, 0 unresolved imports, 1 workflow entry, and no source edits.

known_false_positives: Static compiler resolution cannot prove dynamic runtime reachability or external consumers.
A TypeScript diagnostic count is not an ESLint policy or architectural verdict.
known_false_negatives: Dynamic import, runtime loader, string-based module name, and framework registry edges are intentionally absent.
Cross-project package/reference resolution is not yet an accepted complete scope.
Excluded and symlinked paths are intentionally not analyzed.
legitimate_similar_shapes: An index barrel re-export is reported explicitly rather than mistaken for a direct implementation import.
A generated/vendor/test source or directly targeted excluded file produces an empty eligible inventory, not an inclusion bypass.
Unresolved source is partial evidence, never a zero-edge complete map.

generalized: Explicit partial and unavailable output states
did_not_generalize: Python AST clustering and open-question logic
A shared Compiler API service or parser platform

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: Named project-local tsconfig Compiler API module resolver
evidence: The map needs inventory, exports, inbound/outbound resolution, barrel evidence, and partial-map reporting as one installed artifact.
No accepted boundary/folder proposal demonstrates the same output, failure, direct-target exclusion, and stock-closure contract.

rust.native_tool: rust-analyzer or a compiler-backed crate graph plus syn
rust.idiomatic_representation: pub items, use/re-export edges, mod.rs/lib.rs boundaries, Cargo workspace members

go.idiomatic_representation: exported identifiers, package imports, module replace directives

java_or_kotlin.idiomatic_representation: public declarations, package imports, Gradle/Maven source sets

csharp.idiomatic_representation: public symbols, using/project references, solution boundaries

ruby.idiomatic_representation: public constants, require/re-export convention, gem boundaries

install_steps: Set MAP_SUBSYSTEM_SOURCE to a pinned source/ref and run the documented stock add command.
From the host root, run the documented TypeScript map command with MAP_NAME, MAP_TARGET, and MAP_TSCONFIG when defaults do not fit.
Read durable Markdown and JSON evidence; inspect partial/unavailable fields before planning follow-up work.
agent_confusions: A lexical import list cannot claim alias resolution or complete module facts.
A TypeScript Program does not establish framework/runtime reachability.
A direct excluded target and symlink path must obey the same root-relative policy as a broad root.
repeated_work: Existing TypeScript pilots supplied stock-install and host-pinned package-resolution patterns, but no reusable resolver runtime was imported.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: After an independently accepted second module-resolution consumer, decide whether an identical resolver contract merits a shared utility.

residual_risks: Dynamic/runtime imports and cross-project package/reference analysis remain deliberately unavailable.
The host must provide Node, package.json, a project-local TypeScript package, and a valid named tsconfig.
ESLint remains explicit unavailable rather than a host-policy result.
The advisory ecosystem consistency baseline is stale for many unrelated branch changes; serial integration owns catalog/router/tracker review.

next_decision.recommendation: Accept the narrow TypeScript module-fact map and keep the resolver family-local.
next_decision.rationale: The final map, direct/alias and barrel evidence, project-root exclusions, explicit partial/unavailable states, native tsc, and stock copied-install replay prove a useful outcome without a parser-platform or framework claim.
blockers: Serial integrator must decide shared router/catalog/tracker updates outside this lane.
